<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. XXII, 3 Ar. (ed. קטע; h. text בקע). Targ. Jud. V, 26, v. 
<xref rid="Q01389">פְּעַע</xref>.—Gen. R. s. 93 (ref. to בי, Gen. XLIV, 18) בי ולא ביה … אם למִפְצַע קיסין אנא וכ' take me, not him (Benjamin), if for drawing water, I am (strong enough to do it), if for attendance, I am &c., if for splitting wood, I &c.—Part. pass. פָּצִיעַ; f. פְּצִיעָא. Ib. s. 68 דין מוחיה פ' (some ed. פצועין, corr. acc.) this one had his skull fractured; Lev. R. s. 8 פְּצִיעָה; Num. R. s. 3 דין רישיה פצוע ודין ידיה פצוע (corr. acc.) the one had his head broken, the other, his arm; Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 5; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>

<entry id="Q01441">
<head-word>פֶּצַע</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>wound</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Gen. 38 (ref. to Gen. IV, 23) וכי איש אשר הרגתי וכי פצעתיו מזיד שיהא הפ' קרוי על שמי was it a man I killed? and did I wound him wilfully, that the wound should be called by my name?; Tanḥ. B’resh. 11; a. fr.—Num. R. s. 10, v. פָּצַע.—
<plural-form>Pl. פְּצָעִים,</plural-form> constr. פִּצְעֵי. Ib. Gen. R. s. 22 (ref. to Gen. l. c.) דבר שהוא עושה פ' he struck him with something which makes open wounds (with a stone). Ib. s. 23 שיבואו עלי פ' בשבילו that wounds (sufferings) must come upon me on his account? Yeb. 63
<sup>b</sup> (quot. fr. Ben Sira) רבים היו פצעי רוכל וכ' many have been the wounds of the peddlers that lead to indecencies (by selling exciting perfumes); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="Q01449">
<head-word>פָּקַד</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to search, examine</italic>] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to visit</italic>; (euphem.) 
<italic>to have marital connection with</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 62
<sup>b</sup> ואינו פוֹקְדָהּ and does not visit her (in due time, v. עוֹנָה I). Ib. חייב אדם לִפְקוֹד וכו' a man is bound to visit his wife before going on a journey.—Treat. S’maḥ. ch. VIII יוצאין … ופוֹקְדִין על המתים וכ' you may go out to the burial ground and call upon the dead until three days (after being placed in the sepulchral chamber), and there is no superstitious practice in that; מעשה שפְּקָדוֹ אחד וכ' it occurred that one visited an entombed person, and the latter (was found living and) lived twenty years thereafter; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (of the Lord) 
<italic>to visit, remember, decree upon</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Vayera 14 בלשון … אני פוֹקְדָךְ with the same expression … I will remember thee (bless thee with issue). Ib. הרוני פוֹקֵד לאברהם וכ' I will remember Abraham (relieve him from impotence) at the same time with Abimelech (ref. to Gen. XX, 17-XXI, 1). Pesik. R. s. 43 כשבא לפקוד את חנה when the Lord came to visit Hannah; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. פָּקוּד; f. פְּקוּדָה; 
<plural-form>pl. פְּקוּדִים, פְּקוּדִין; פְּקוּדוֹת</plural-form>. Snh. 97
<sup>a</sup> עד שהראשונה פ' שנייה וכ' while the first calamity is remembered (by the Lord for delivery), the second quickly comes.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to count, muster</italic>; v. 
<xref rid="Q01454">פָּקוּד</xref>, 
<xref rid="Q01486">פְּקִידָה</xref>, 
<xref rid="Q00801">פִּיקּוּד.</xref></definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (denom. of פָּקִיד, interch.</definition>
<notes> with 
<italic>Hif.</italic>) 
<italic>to give in charge, entrust, deposit</italic>. Pesik. R. l. c. בעל פקדונות אני … פּוֹקֵד אצלי אני נותן לו I (the Lord) am a trustee, whatever a man deposits with me, I give back to him. Ib. נפשות פְּקַדְתֶּם אצלי וכ' you (Abraham and Sarah) deposited souls with me (converted souls to the belief in me), I will pay you back in souls (ref. to Gen. XXI, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<definition>פָּקִיד) 
<italic>to command, order</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. s. 42 פָּקַדְתִּי לאדם וכ' I gave Adam a command, and he did not do it; פקדתי למלאך וכ' I commissioned the angel of death, and he did (what I commanded him). Shebu. VII, 7 (45
<sup>a</sup>) שבועה שלא פְּקָדָנוּ אבא we swear that our father has not left us any order (concerning this case); Y. Keth. VII, 33
<sup>b</sup> פִּיקְּדָנוּ. Shebu. 48
<sup>b</sup> מה לי שלא פְקָרַנֵי אבא ושלא פקדני אחי what is the difference between the oath of an heir ‘that my father 
<pgbrk id="pg1207" />has not left me an order’, and ‘that my brother &c.’?; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>פִּיקֵּד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same, v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִפְקַד, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְפַּקֵּד, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa.</italic> נִתְפַּקֵּד </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be visited, remembered, decreed upon</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 53 בשעה שנִפְקְדָה … נִפְקְדוּ עמה when Sarah was visited &c., v. עֲקָרָה. Ib. אינו דין שתִּפָּקֵד is it not right that she should be visited? Tanḥ. Vayera 13 תהי נִפְקֶדֶת she shall be remembered. R. Hash. 11
<sup>a</sup>. Pesik. R. s. 42 בדין הוא שיִפָּקֵד אברהם it is right that Abraham be visited. Ib. שתִּתְפַּקֵּד אף היא that she be likewise visited. Lev. R. s. 29; Pesik. Baḥod., p. 150
<sup>b</sup> (quot. from Rab’s New Year’s prayer) ובריות בו יִפָּקֵדוּ להזכירם וכ' and creatures are passed upon on that day to record them for life or for death; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be commanded, commissioned</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. l. c. יש שנתפ' ולא עשה וכ' some are commanded and do not (what they are ordered to) &c. Mekh. B’shall., Vayassʿa, s. 4 עשו מה שנִתְפַּקְּדוּ they did what they were commanded to do; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִפְקִיד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to give in charge, deposit</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. III, 1 המַפְקִיד אצל וכ' if a man deposits for safe-keeping with his neighbor &c. Ib. 36
<sup>a</sup> sq. כל המפקיד על דעת אשתו ובניו הוא מפקיד he who deposits with his neighbor, does so with the presumptive condition that the latter’s wife and children be also trustees (and it was no breach of trust to leave the deposit in their charge). Gen. R. s. 53 עמלק ה' אצלי וכ' Amalek deposited with me bundles of thorns (wrong-doings) &c.; שרה הִפְקִידָה אצלי וכ' Sarah deposited with me virtues and good deeds &c. Pesik. R. s. 43; a. fr.—B. Mets. 35
<sup>a</sup> ופרקין המפקיד הוה and our subject at college was 
<italic>hammafḳid</italic> (the Mishnah B. Mets. l. c. and the discussions concerning it).—Part. pass. מוּפְקָד; f. מוּפְקֶדֶת &c. B. Kam. 105
<sup>a</sup> כגון שהיתה … מופ' ביד אחרים when his father’s bag was left in trust with other people; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to take charge of</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Deut. 847 הַפְקֵד לי הפקדון הזה take this object in charge for me.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="Q01451">
<head-word>פִּקָּדוֹן</head-word>
<head-word>פִּיקָּ'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>thing given in charge, deposit</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 93, beg. לית שמיה פקדון אלא פּוּק דּוֹן (some ed. פוקדון in one word) it ought not to be called 
<italic>piḳḳadon</italic>, but 
<italic>puḳ don</italic> (go out of this, avoid it; דון for דין). Shebu. V, 1 שבועת הפ' the oath concerning a deposit. Ib. 2 תן לי פִקְדּוֹנִי give me my deposit back. Ib. VI, 7 מי שהפ' אצלו the trustee. Num. R. s. 9 (ref. to Num. V, 12 ומעלה בו מעל, a. Lev. V, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> לפי שהיא כופרת בפ' because she betrays a trust; מה ממון הקל כל הכופר בפ' … בפִקְדּוֹן גוף וכ' if in money matters which are of slighter import, he who denies a deposit is considered like denying the Lord, how much more so is one who denies the deposit of a body (purity of the family)!</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Shof’ṭim 12 פ' אחד … תן לו פִּקְדּוֹנוֹ וכ' one deposit has he (the Lord) with thee, give it back to him and make thyself a god; ומה פקדונו וכ' and what is his deposit? Said she, the soul within thee; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. פִּקְדּוֹנוֹת, פִּיקְ'</plural-form>. Gen. R. l. c. ברח מן הפ' flee from receiving trusts; Yeb. 109
<sup>a</sup>.—בעל פ' 
<italic>trustee</italic>. Gen. R. s. 53; Pesik. R. s. 43, v. פָּקַד; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>

<notes> Gen. R. s. 32 אינו מספיק … עד שהיא פוֹקַעַת he scarcely beats it (the bad flax) once, when it bursts; ib. s. 34; Yalk. Is. 350. Gen. R. l. c. שאינו מקיש עליהם אחת עד שהיא פוקעת he knocks at them (the bad earthen vessels) scarcely once, and one is cracked (ib. s. 32 עד שהוא שוברם). Y. Maasr. III, 50
<sup>d</sup> top פעמים שהיא פוקעת וכ' sometimes it (the fig) bursts under the wheel. Zeb. IX, 6 גחלת שפָּקְעָה מעל וכ' a coal that sprang from the altar; אברים שפָּקְעוּ וכ' chips of limbs that sprang off the altar. Tosef. Par. III (II), 11 פ' מעורה וכ' if a part of her skin … (in burning the red cow) leaped off beyond the pit. Ib. 12. Yalk. Num. 761 את הפּוֹקְעִין the portions which spring off, v. פֶּקַע; a. fr.—Pesik. R. s. 11 או שמא תִפְקַע האוזן וכ' (or תִפָּקַע 
<italic>Nif.</italic>) or (I would venture to say it, were I not afraid,) lest the ear of the hearer burst, i.e. it is almost blasphemous to say it; (Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 2 כדי שתבקע אוזן it is enough for an ear to burst). Y. Yeb. I, 2
<sup>c</sup> bot. פקעו ממנה קידושין (not ופקעו) the betrothal rebounds from her, i.e. has no legal effect, opp. חלו עליה.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. פָּקוּעַ; f. פְּקוּעָה 
<italic>an animal which is ripped open;</italic> בן (ה) פ' an animal taken alive out of the slaughtered mother’s womb. Ḥull. 69
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>פִּקֵּעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to cause splitting</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Pes. VII, 35
<sup>b</sup> top שלא לפַקֵּעַ תחת הבשר in order not to cause a splitting of the bone under the flesh, v. פֶּקַע.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִפְקִיעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to split, break open</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. III, 3 (38
<sup>b</sup>) לא יַפְקִיעֶנָּה בסודרין he must not break it (the egg) over a hot cloth, Rashi (oth. interpret.: he must not cause it to crack by wrapping it in a hot cloth and rolling it; v. Tosaf. Yom Tob a. l.).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to strip, pluck, ravel out</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bets. 31
<sup>b</sup> מתיר ומַפְקִיעַ וחותך may untie (the knot, v. חוֹתָם), or ravel out or cut through; Sabb. 146
<sup>a</sup>; Y. ib. XV, beg. 15
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. ומַפְקִיעִין, v. פִּקְפֵּק. Succ. V, 3 מהן היו מַפְקִיעִין ובהן היו מדליקין they stripped them (the worn-out belts of priests) and used them for wicks; Sabb. 21
<sup>a</sup> בגדי … מפקיעין אותן ומהן היו עושין פתילות וכ' they ravelled out priestly garments and made of them wicks &c.; expl. Y. Succ. V, 55
<sup>b</sup> bot. מפשילים, v. פָּשַׁל. Esth. R. to I, 6 הכל מפקיעין בחבלי וכ' all make straps (for their couches) of woolen or flax ropes, and this wicked man uses byssus and purple; a. fr.—2) [
<italic>to cause breaking loose</italic>,] 
<italic>to release, cancel an obligation</italic>. Yeb. 66
<sup>b</sup> sq., a. fr. הקדש … מפקיעין מידי שעבוד consecration (of a pledged object), leavened matter (on the entrance of Passover), and liberation (of a pledged slave) cause a release from mortgage (cancel the mortgage contract). Bekh. 5
<sup>a</sup> אין בכור מפקיע בכור a first-born Levite could not serve as ransom for a first-born Israelite; דיו לבכור שיַפְקִיעַ וכ' it was enough for the firstborn Levite that he released his own consecration (that he needed no priest to be substituted for him); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> ה' השער 
<italic>to break up, unsettle the market, to raise prices arbitrarily, create a panic</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. II, 9 שלא להַפְקִיעַ השערים in order not to cause a sudden rise of market prices (by creating the impression of impending scarcity). Meg. 17
<sup>b</sup> כנגד מַפְקִיעֵי שערים a prayer against those who raise prices (speculating on a coming scarcity).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>a</sup> מְפַקְפְּקִין ומפקיעין וכ' (not בו) you may loosen the knot, or ravel it out, or untie &c., v. פָּקַע; מפקפקין ולא מפקיעין you may loosen the knot, but not ravel it out; ib. XX, end, 17
<sup>d</sup>; Y. Meg. I, 71

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>to insert a wedge or coil in one’s mouth, be gagged, estopped from speaking</italic>.</definition>

Bub.] אם הן באין אצלך לדין מה אתה עושה ואתה מְפַקְפֵּק בדבר ואין אתה יכול להוציאו וכ' if men will come to thee for judgment, what wilt thou do? Thou wilt gag (thy mouth) with a word and be unable to bring it out, when they will say, has he not done so unto Nabal? Thus the text (I Sam. l. c.) reads, ‘and let this not be unto thee a stopper’, אל תְּפַקְפֵּק בפיך וכ' do not put a gag in thy mouth (do not make thyself unable to give judgment boldly), nor say &c.; Yalk. <entry id="Q01517">

<senses>
<sense>

<notes>) [
<italic>to break through;</italic> cmp. פָּרַץ,] </notes></sense>

<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be free, licentious, irreverent, sceptical</italic>.</definition>

<sup>b</sup> מתוך תשובה … פָּקְרוּ המינים Ms. M. (ed. המערערים) from the answer which Aaron gave to Moses (Ex. XXXII, 24) the heretics derived their heresy (to assert the reality of idolatrous witchcraft). Snh. 38
<sup>b</sup> כל מקום שפקרו המינין וכ' Ms. M. (ed. הצדוקים) wherever in a Biblical passage the heretics seem to find a support for their scepticism (belief in a plurality of divine beings), their refutation is always near by; Y. Ber. IX, 12
<sup>d</sup> bot. (not שפרקו); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (with עַצְמ־) 
<italic>to make free with one’s self</italic>; (of a woman) 
<italic>to propose marriage to a man</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. II, 20
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to I Sam. XXV, 31 וזכרת את אמתך) מלמד שפָּקְרָה עצמה this shows that she intimated eventual marriage to David; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>

<senses>
<sense>

<italic>to declare free, to renounce ownership, declare a property ownerless</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 38
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. המַפְקִיר עבדו יצא לחירות if one declares his slave ownerless, he goes out free (and needs no letter of emancipation); ib. 39
<sup>a</sup> המפקיר … וצריך וכ' he is entitled to his liberty, but requires a letter of emancipation. Yalk. Kings 224 ה' כל אשר לו (not הפקיד) he gave up all he possessed. Tanḥ. Pinḥas 2 בת מלך הִפְקִירוּ לקלון they offered a king’s daughter to prostitution; ה' בתו מי לא היה מפקיר he (the king) offered his daughter, who would not do the same?; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּפְקַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be declared free</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Peah VI, 1 עד שיוּפְקַר וכ' (Ms. M. שיבקר, read as Eduy. IV, 3 שׁיוּבְקַר) until it is declared free also for rich men; a. e.—Part. pass. מוּפְקָר; f. מוּפְקֶרֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מוּפְקָרִים, מוּפְקָרִין; מוּפְקָרוֹת</plural-form>. Snh. 49
<sup>a</sup> מה מדבר מ' לכל אף ביתו … מ' לכל as the desert is free to all, so was Joab’s house free to all (that craved his hospitality). Tanḥ. Vayaḳhel 8 למה … מה המדבר מ' … התורה מ' וכ' why was the Law given in the desert? To intimate that as the desert is free to all, so are the words of the Law free to every one &c. Gen. R. s. 72 דבר שהוא מן המ' something which is free (ownerless); a. fr.—V. הֶפְקֵר.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>a</sup>. Pesik. R. s. 15 רמז לפרגמטטין וכ' this is a hint to travelling merchants and seafarers to remember and come home quickly; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>b</sup> בפַרְוָארֵי); Tosef. Ter. II, 10 פרואר ed. Zuck. (Var. פרוארי, פרוד; פרוזדר, corr. acc.). Tosef. Ab. Zar. VII (VIII), 10 פרואר שישראל וכ' ed. Zuck. (Var. פרזר, פרזא, corr. acc.) a market to which an Israelite and a gentile bring wine; Y. ib. IV, end, 44
